definitions.name: S0C.SUM
definitions.note: sum of a numeric Vector as a bare scalar

definitions.name: S0C.MEAN
definitions.note: arithmetic mean of a numeric Vector as a bare scalar

definitions.name: S0C.DEVIATIONS
definitions.note: Vector of each element minus the mean

definitions.name: S0C.VARIANCE
definitions.note: population variance as a bare scalar

definitions.name: S0C.STDDEV
definitions.note: population standard deviation (exact) as a bare scalar

definitions.name: S0C.MAX
definitions.body: 'S0C.X' BIND S0C.X S0C.X 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: largest element of a non-empty numeric Vector

definitions.name: S0C.MIN
definitions.body: 'S0C.N' BIND S0C.N S0C.N 0 GET [ MIN ] FOLD
definitions.note: smallest element of a non-empty numeric Vector

definitions.name: S0C.RANGE
definitions.note: max minus min of a numeric Vector

definitions.name: S0C.NORMALIZE
definitions.body: 'S0C.Z' BIND S0C.Z S0C.Z S0C.MIN - S0C.Z S0C.RANGE /
definitions.note: min-max rescale of a numeric Vector to [0,1]

definitions.name: S0C.WORDS
definitions.note: split a String on single spaces into a Vector of words

definitions.name: S0C.LENGTHS
definitions.note: character count of each String in a Vector

definitions.name: S0C.TITLECASE
definitions.body: CHARS 'S0C.C' BIND S0C.C [ UPPER ] MAP S0C.C [ ' ' ] S0C.C -1 DROP CONCAT [ ' ' = ] MAP SELECT JOIN
definitions.note: upper-case the first letter of every space-separated word in a String

solutions.text.acronym: S0C.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET ] MAP JOIN UPPER
